replies.author: ParthDarthVader
replies.body:
If you have windows you can download the .rar file and then right click on it and press "Open With". Then you go to "Choose Default Program" and then a window will pop up. Select "Windows File Explorer" and click ok.

so from ten on, ever time you download a .rar file it will automatically be converted into a .zip file.

i don't know about Mac though....
